To feel more confident in your choice, you can:

Identify the notes you enjoy (floral, fruity, amber, woody, etc.).
Think about when you’ll wear it: lighter scents for everyday, more intense ones for evenings or events.
Test on your skin, as fragrances react differently from one person to another.

To guide you step by step, you can use our online fragrance-finding immersive experience to discover which of our fragrances best matches your tastes and occasions.
